attributes.board_name: Oklahoma State Board of Behavioral Health Licensure

rules.accepted_credit_types: Counseling-related CE meeting OAC 86:10-17-3 (qualified presenter; college course, in-service, workshop, conference, home-study or distance course; ACA, APA, AAMFT, NASW, NAADAC national conferences; state/federal mental health agency programs). Board pre-approves ACA/OCA, APA/OPA, AAMFT/OKAMFT, NASW, NAADAC/ODAPCA, ODMHSAS, OK MHP licensing boards and Board-approved providers. 1 graduate semester credit = 15 clock hours.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial license runs 2 years from the end of the issue month; first renewal requires 40 hours, then a prorated interim period to the next June 30, then annual renewals.
rules.carryover: Not allowed: only CE accrued in the preceding renewal period is accepted.
rules.audit_note: Each May the Board randomly audits 2–25% of active LPCs; keep attendance documents for 2 years.

topics.who: All LPCs: counseling ethics (incl. OK LPC rules, Subchapter 3)

rules.notes: Annual renewal due June 30. Home-study/distance CE allowed if it meets Board criteria; no hour cap stated. Teaching earns 2 h per hour taught, max 10 h/year. CE hours entered in the Thentia licensee portal at renewal.
rules.rule_quote: (a) Licensees shall complete and furnish documentation to the Board of twenty (20) clock hours of continuing education per year.
